value.author: Zied
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: الاستقبال كار رائع و نظافة الغرفة ايضا

value.author: Ashoubi
value.title: Excellent
value.text:
كان الفندق جيدًا ونظيفًا للغاية، وقد استمتعت بكل شيء منذ لحظة دخولي إلى الغرفة، ويوجد ميني بار داخل الغرفة يمكنك استخدامه، ولكن بدفع رسوم رمزية للغاية، كانت الغرفة التي أمتلكها اقتصادية، لكنهم كانوا يستحقون ذلك. لقد قاموا بترقية الغرفة مجانًا، وقد فاجأوني وأنا ممتن لهم، حيث يعد الوصول الجيد جدًا إلى المطاعم ومراكز التسوق في شارع الاستقلال أحد مزايا هذا الفندق ويمكن القول أنه يتمتع بأفضل موقع، الشخص. في الاستقبال شخص يعرف لغات مختلفة. (وحيد) وقدرت على التواصل دون أي مشاكل وقد ساعدني ذلك كثيرًا، شكرًا لك على إعطائي ليلة جميلة.
— جمیله

value.author: Mohamad84
value.title: جيد
value.text:
كل شيئ كان جيد
— الموقع

value.author: Ali
value.title: رحله جيدة
value.text:
اشكر الأخت  سار علي حسن الاستقبال والمعامله 
الفندق ممتاز وقريب من الخدمات وجميع الموظفين كأنو في حسن الاستقبال
— لا شي

value.author: Diala
value.title: مرضي
value.text:
غرفة نظيفة و سرير مريح 
الموقع ممتاز 
الموظفون لطيفين 
تدفئة جيدة
— الغرفة و الحمام صغيران نوعا ما. 
الإفطار متوسط  و القهوة لابأس 
احيانا لم يوجد ماء ساخن للحمام

value.author: Babaei

value.text: Great breakfast and coffee, fast Wi-Fi, perfect location, good price, and a comfortable bed. Highly recommended!

value.author: Brigitta
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: Everything was great and well worth it. The location was excellent, and the staff were friendly and helpful. Great service overall.

value.author: Ouissem
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: Great location, clean and comfortable room, good breakfast and coffee. The staff were really friendly and helpful. Would stay again!

value.author: Lucian
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: Locație excelentă, aproape de stațiile de transport în comun și de toate atracțiile.

value.author: Margot
value.title: Great hotel if you’re looking for something in this price range (fantastic value for money), with a superbly welcoming s
value.text:
Great hotel if you’re looking for something in this price range (fantastic value for money), with a superbly welcoming service ! There’s aircon and a fridge in the room which is great.
— The area is a bit noisy at night (not very well isolated from noise) but that’s not a problem if you bring earplugs with you. The sheets are a bit scratchy to my taste but again that’s a detail :).

value.author: Ildiko
value.title: رائع
value.text:
Minden egy szóval. Udvarias, kedves, segítőkész recepciósok 🙂  A szoba tiszta volt. Mindennel meg voltam elégedve.
— Sajnos az nem tetszett hogy nem tudtam aludni a zajtól amit az utcában tartózkodók  csináltak. Utolsó reggel 2 férfi úgy veszekedett, ordibált hogy már pihenni sem lehetett. 3 órát talán sikerült aludnom a zajtól.

value.author: Parsa
value.title: On se sent comme à la maison
value.text:
Nous avons réservé deux chambres dans cet hôtel et nous y avons séjourné en famille. Nous avons passé un séjour vraiment très agréable et nous sommes entièrement satisfaits.

Un grand merci à l’équipe de la réception ainsi qu’au personnel d’entretien, qui a constamment été attentif à notre confort. Ils nous demandaient régulièrement si nous avions besoin de quelque chose et si le nettoyage des chambres nous convenait. Nous avons beaucoup apprécié leur gentillesse et leur professionnalisme.

Les équipements des chambres étaient très satisfaisants : un coffre-fort, de l’eau chaude, une connexion Wi-Fi rapide et fiable, ainsi que tout le nécessaire pour un séjour confortable.

L’emplacement est excellent. L’hôtel se trouve tout près de Taksim et à deux pas de l’avenue Istiklal. C’est un quartier très animé et touristique, avec un accès facile à tous les principaux sites de la ville.

Le petit-déjeuner était également très bon. Les produits étaient frais, le choix était varié et largement suffisant. Après le petit-déjeuner, nous avons été invités à découvrir leur café, situé juste en face de l’hôtel. Nous y avons commandé des boissons, et ils nous ont agréablement surpris en nous offrant une part de cheesecake au citron pour chaque boisson commandée. C’était un geste très attentionné, et le cheesecake était absolument délicieux.

La propreté était irréprochable. L’intérieur de l’hôtel était toujours impeccable, les chambres étaient nettoyées chaque jour avec soin, et nous avons même remarqué que les abords de l’hôtel étaient entretenus quotidiennement.

Dans l’ensemble, nous avons passé un séjour très agréable. Nous recommandons cet hôtel sans hésitation et nous y reviendrons avec plaisir lors d’un prochain voyage.
— J'aurais aimé que nous puissions rester plus longtemps.

value.author: Yiying
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: I stayed here for 3 nights and honestly felt at home. The room was always clean, the bed was really comfortable, and it was quiet enough to get a good night’s sleep. Everyone I met was kind and welcoming without feeling forced. It’s not easy to find a hotel in this area that offers this level of comfort for the price. I’d definitely choose it again.

value.author: Gazmend
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: I stayed here for a few nights and felt comfortable from the moment I checked in. The room had everything I needed, the WiFi was reliable, and the staff were always polite without being over the top. Definitely good value, especially for this area

value.author: Parsa
value.title: Pleasent and reasonable
value.text:
I recently stayed at this hotel and had a wonderful experience. I can confidently recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

The location is excellent. It is very close to Taksim, which made it easy to access many attractions, restaurants, shops, and public transportation. Having everything within easy reach made my stay even more convenient.

Overall, I was very satisfied with everything. The staff were always professional, polite, and welcoming. They treated me with great respect and made me feel valued as a guest.

The breakfast offered a wide variety of delicious options. I also really appreciated the café’s special offer. I ordered a drink, and they pleasantly surprised me by serving a complimentary slice of lemon cheesecake. It was a thoughtful gesture that made a great impression.

The cleanliness throughout the hotel was excellent. My room, the lobby, and all the common areas were spotless and well maintained. I am quite sensitive when it comes to cleanliness, but I didn’t notice anything that concerned me during my stay.

The hotel’s facilities were more than adequate for my needs. The Wi-Fi was very fast and reliable, and everything I needed during my stay was available.

Overall, I had a fantastic experience and would definitely choose this hotel again. Thank you to the entire team for your outstanding hospitality and excellent service!
— Nothing important just i wish i could’ve stay longer

value.author: Mariam
value.title: استثنائي
value.text:
I stayed for three nights and had a really pleasant experience. For this area, it’s honestly hard to find such a clean and comfortable hotel at this price. I loved the breakfast and coffee, and the staff were all very friendly and helpful. The room was clean, the bed was comfortable, and having a minibar and safe was a nice bonus. The WiFi was good, there’s an elevator, and I also liked the calm music in the lobby. 
Overall, great value for money and definitely recommended.

value.author: Yiling
value.title: استثنائي
value.text:
I had a great stay at this hotel.
It has an elevator, a comfortable lobby with plenty of seating, and a delicious breakfast.
The beds were very comfortable, and the room was clean and well-equipped with everything I needed.
The Wi-Fi was fast and reliable throughout my stay.
The location is excellent, just a short walk from the main street. The staff were kind and welcoming throughout my stay. It offers great value for money, and I would definitely recommend it.

value.author: Aref
value.title: جيد جداً
value.text:
I had a great 9 night stay at this hotel. The room was clean and comfortable, the bed was excellent, the Wi-Fi was fast, and the location was very convenient. The staff were friendly and professional, and overall it offered good value for money.
— The breakfast variety was not as extensive as shown in the booking photos. Also, the water pressure on the 6th floor was low, and it took several minutes for the water to become hot. Additionally, I noticed some mold in the bathroom, especially around the shower area and underneath the vanity, which could be improved through better maintenance.

value.author: Dominik
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: A very pleasant experience from check-in to check-out. Everything was just as expected. Highly recommended!

value.author: Ahmed
value.title: استثنائي
value.text:
Everything was perfect.
I would definitely stay here again.
highly recommend this hotel.

value.author: Raed
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: A very enjoyable stay. The breakfast was good, the location was excellent, the staff were kind and welcoming, and the room was clean and comfortable. Great value overall.

value.author: Mohamed
value.title: استثنائي
value.text: The hotel was clean, comfortable, and great value for money. The cozy lobby, free drinking water, and elevator made the stay more convenient. The room had everything I needed, the beds were comfortable, and the location was excellent. I’d definitely stay here again.

value.title: استثنائي
value.text: The hotel was clean and comfortable, the staff were helpful, and the location was very convenient. It was also good value for the price.
